note: Sealed anomaly ledger for decision 14.11: hashes and facts only, never prices. Raw rows are never modified, replaced or deleted.

anomalies.neutral_description: SPY.US 2020-11-18 的 OHLC 不一致（open > high），无法确定错误字段

read_set_reasoning.open: 2020-11-18 is not the next sealed session after any month-end 2011-12..2021-12 (Oct month-end 2020-10-30 -> next 2020-11-02; Nov month-end 2020-11-30 -> next 2020-12-01), so it is not a potential execution day and its open is outside the read set
read_set_reasoning.high: high is read by no signal, fill or valuation on any day (integrity bound only)
read_set_reasoning.low: low is read by no signal, fill or valuation on any day (integrity bound only)
read_set_reasoning.close: READ: the bar's close stays in the read set; low <= close <= high is still enforced and the whole bar is never skipped

still_enforced_on_this_bar: all four OHLC values finite and > 0
the exemption never asserts that open, high or any other field is correct

provider_reproduction_receipt.earlier_unsaved_probe: an earlier unsaved probe at 2026-09-28T22:02Z gave the same result; only the saved receipt is evidence

cap: at most 1 bar across both symbols and it must match this single registered entry; any other date, any other relation, or any read field gives DATA_BLOCKED
qqq_policy: QQQ.US follows the same field-dependency principle but has no entry on this ledger, so any QQQ OHLC anomaly still blocks

verification.seal: validates this ledger against the registered constants, refuses when missing or tampered, and hashes it into the manifest (ohlc_anomaly_ledger.sha256)
verification.evaluate: re-derives the violation set from the sealed bars of BOTH symbols and requires it to equal this ledger exactly before claiming the attempt; refuses on a missing, tampered or mismatched ledger even if the outer hashes were rewritten consistently
